note: Family-run camp on the east shore of Bridgeport Reservoir off Hwy 182, with gravel back-in and pull-through RV sites on two levels, tent and van dry sites on a lawn at the water's edge, rental trailers, and a few seasonal and mobile-home spaces. The operator calls it ideal for smaller RVs. The reservoir is drawn down through the summer, so the shoreline recedes from late August. Mono County's 15% lodging tax applies to stays under 31 days. --Claude
summary: Rates found on the ResNexus engine: $44 (spring/fall weekday, 28-ft site) to $95 (premium, opener weekend), summer standard $59; 30 A FHU, 42-ft max, pull-throughs, season 2027 Apr 23-Oct 17. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (RV pads 35-55 m behind the tent lawn). Price gate passes only on the shoulder rate. Google 4.8 (373).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (lakefront -> lakeview): only the tent/van dry sites T1-T4 ('closest to the lakeshore', 'front row views'; vans, rooftop tents, no hookups) sit on the lawn at the cove's full-pool edge (~38.2887,-119.2165). The RV sites (site map: lower level 21-31 and 12/26/27 premium) are behind that lawn, its palapas and tree clumps and the lower-level road; the nearest gravel pads (~38.2886,-119.2161) are ~35-55 m from the full-pool edge, not over clean open ground, and the operator never calls an RV site lakefront. All sites are sold by the night (ResNexus) but none of the RV ones passes the ~50 m open-ground test. Replacement evidence: 'Operator: tent/van dry sites closest to the lakeshore, RV sites a short distance behind; Esri + 3DEP + CDEC full pool (6459.8 ft, 2024): lawn at the cove edge, nearest RV pads ~35-55 m back past trees and the lower-level road; lakeview.'

PRICE GATE (private): borderline - cheapest RV night $44.00 before tax (RV up to 28 Feet, 2027 spring/fall weekdays), but $59.00 mid-June to August and $65.00 on the opening weekend; 15% TOT on top ($50.60 / $67.85). Not a Good Sam Park (stored false); no gateway within 40 km (Yosemite NP 42 km). Passes on the shoulder rate only; reviewer's call.
GOOGLE: 4.8 from 373 reviews (Google Maps, 2026-11-27); RV Life 4.5, $$ (stored).

LONG-STAY: nightly in character - 22+ RV units plus tent/van sites on ResNexus, all with nightly rates and availability across the 2027 season; the home page offers 'a limited number of seasonal sites' and the site map shows three mobile homes and a camp-host spot by the highway. Minimum stay 'typically 2-3 nights', relaxed at short notice and none same-day (already stored) - not a standing 3+ night minimum.
